what_it_does: Transformer neural networks spend a lot of time waiting for data to move between the processor and main memory (DRAM), which becomes the bottleneck during inference. This paper describes a specialized accelerator that represents the model's output activations (intermediate results) in a special compressed format that skips unimportant numerical values. By storing fewer numbers in memory, the accelerator reduces the volume of data that needs to travel from DRAM, speeding up the overall computation. The technique works especially well because transformer attention layers produce output where many values are effectively zero or negligible.
